web.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
web.description: A flaw in KVM , the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean .   On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312 , affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled.   Fixed kernels shipped upstream on Tuesday, the day before the research went public. The provider patched its own fleet with a live patch, telling Droplet customers: "No action needed on your part." Operators who run their own KVM hosts on AMD hardware need to update the host kernel or turn nested virtualization off.   Oren Yomtov , a researcher at the security firm Terra Security , found the flaw and reported it through the provider's bug bounty program. web.title: The Path to AI Autonomy in the SOC
web.description: Security leaders are about to hand AI agents a lot more authority. In a recent a16z survey  of CISOs at organizations with more than 1,000 employees, 36% said they are comfortable today letting AI agents act autonomously on low-risk security actions. In 12 months from now, 60% expect to be comfortable at that level. Overall, AI SOC  was the highest ranking initiative for 2027.   The pressure behind the shift is easy to see. web.title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
web.description: A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock  lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine.   The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse , and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker tested it the same day and found it works.   There is no fix from Microsoft yet, and nothing shows the method has been used in a real attack.   The technique does not work on every machine.
